_comment: Particles on any action of any body (scripts/fx/action_fx.gd). bodies.<elian | enemy id>.<trigger>: a list of emitters. A trigger is an animation the body plays (idle, run, attack, hurt…) — an emitter fires at its start (when "start"), on some of its frames (when "frames", frames: [i…]) or every `every` seconds while it plays (when "every") — or an event the game names: step (a footfall), jump, land, roll, wake. An emitter: fx dust | puff | sparkle | ash | debris | ring | flash; at feet | body | head | hand | back, offset [x, y] (x turns with the body); dir [x, y] for dust; count; color #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa; size (puff scale, sparkle width, ash spread, ring and flash radius); rise (ash); chance 0..1. Edited in the art studio, tab «Частицы».
